<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series (spacing ~1 Da, M+1 ≈11 % of M, diminishing higher peaks) the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing ~10 carbons. No other characteristic isotope patterns (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are evident, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
